passage: The morning train left the station a few minutes late. Most of the passengers were reading or looking out at the wet fields. A young woman near the door opened her notebook and began to write a long letter to her brother. She told him about the new house, the garden that needed work, and the neighbours who had already invited her to dinner. By the time the train reached the coast, the rain had stopped and the sea was bright under a pale sky. She folded the letter, put it in her coat, and smiled.
